dmp.description:
The research questions we want to address are the following:
1. obtain the number of citations included in Meta which refer to publication in SSH (Social Sciences and Humanities) journals indicated in ERIH-PLUS, by looking at citations data contained in COCI
2. discover what are the disciplines citing the most and the disciplines which are cited the most
3. what are the citations from/to publication contained in Meta which are not included in SSH journals 

We want to create a connection between these three different datasets for having an overall view of the citations present in each of them.
